profile.name: ESP32微控制器开发板
profile.description: 这是一类基于 ESP32 芯片的微控制器开发板或嵌入式设备，通常通过串口与计算机连接，可用于烧录固件、调试程序以及进行无线与传感实验等开发工作。在实验室中，它常用于嵌入式原型验证、数据采集控制和物联网功能测试。
profile.description_en: This is a microcontroller development board or embedded device based on the ESP32 chip. It is typically connected to a computer over a serial interface for firmware flashing, program debugging, and wireless or sensing experiments. In the lab, it is commonly used for embedded prototyping, data acquisition/control tasks, and IoT function testing.

registry.description: Flash Firmware是一款实验执行&合成设备。支持Signal, Slot, ask quit等操作。
